source_resolution.rule: After exact ratification and implementation, resolve every model/tokenizer file from the named immutable repository revision, reject symlinks or files whose resolved object is outside that snapshot, sort paths by UTF-8 byte order, and record SHA-256 plus byte count for every file in the new pre-GPU executable snapshot. Missing, duplicate, mutable, network-fetched-after-snapshot, or changed bytes yield NOT_RUN. This proposal does not claim that the resolved files or receipt already exist.
source_resolution.chat_template_source: the exact chat_template string value in tokenizer_config.json at the named revision, encoded as UTF-8 with no newline insertion
source_resolution.required_hashes: SHA-256 for each required tokenizer file, UTF-8 chat-template bytes, every weight/config file, and the complete sorted snapshot manifest; hashes are evidence values determined solely by the immutable source rule, not implementation choices

software.canonical_json: Exact RFC8785 JCS semantics over I-JSON, emitted as UTF-8 with no BOM/newline; reject duplicate object names before canonicalization, malformed UTF-8, non-Unicode-scalar strings, non-I-JSON numbers, and any noncanonical byte input where canonical input is required. Unicode scalar validation uses the frozen Unicode 15.1.0 boundary. No normalization, case folding, locale transform, or implementation-defined key ordering is permitted.
software.selection_status: These literals are proposal-chosen allowed values, not a claim that the stack has been built, is mutually compatible, or is available on a current lease.
software.version_rule: After separate ratification, implementation must build exactly this stack and exact frozen semantics, then record exact public version strings plus installed source-tree and binary SHA-256 values in a newly hashed executable snapshot. A local-version suffix, patched wheel, alternate dependency, source-byte change, or scientific-semantic change is a different envelope. If the exact stack cannot build, import, tokenize, load the exact model, or pass every maximum fixture, the roster is NOT_RUN and any replacement requires a new material change and ratification.

executable_identity.current_state: No post-ratification implementation, installed-source, binary, JCS-implementation, model-snapshot, tokenizer, chat-template, or executable-receipt hashes are asserted to exist in this proposal.
executable_identity.required_future_snapshot_stage: After exact human ratification and scoped implementation, and before any GPU/model-token execution, create a new pre-GPU executable snapshot; JCS-canonicalize and hash it; rehash every proposal contract/schema/prompt/fixture source it binds; and obtain fresh independent review of the complete snapshot bytes.
required_future_snapshot_hashes: the exact JCS implementation source and executable/binary
parser and Unicode-validation implementation source and binary
assignment generator, identifier/RNG, renderer, extractor, reader, reducer, actor, solver, reporter, and resource-accounting source and binaries
maximum fixtures and their generated expected bytes
executable_identity.review_and_gate: A fresh independent reviewer must verify source-to-binary/hash completeness, exact conformance to all already-frozen algorithms/semantics, all required static fixtures, and absence of an unreviewed executable input. Only the newly hashed and independently accepted snapshot may be named by a later explicit pre-GPU approval.
executable_identity.no_choice_rule: Implementation may choose no new scientific algorithm, identity input, ordinal mapping, parser/JCS/Unicode behavior, renderer/extractor/reader/reducer behavior, runtime value, resource rule, cell, or failure consequence. Any needed scientific choice or semantic change returns to material deliberation and exact human ratification; it cannot be hidden in implementation or review.

explicit_exclusions: any device with less than 96 GiB physical HBM
eligible_hardware.availability_statement: The proposal does not assert that eligible hardware or a lease is currently available. Availability is an external prerequisite, never permission to change TP, precision, context, or model.

request_policy.recurrent_dream_max_new_tokens: min(2048, raw_output_tokens_remaining) selected before generation; after parsing, accepted READ/NOTICE/CONNECT/REVISE is capped at 512, PREDICT at 2048, and PASS/COMMIT/ABSTAIN at 256
request_policy.malformed_charge: all raw generated tokens through stop/timeout are charged to the request and phase; parse failure cannot reduce the charge

think_phase_resource_accounting.remainder_field: phase_tokens_remaining_before and phase_tokens_remaining_after in every scientific call resource record; raw_output_tokens_remaining in every rendered recurrent Think budget
think_phase_resource_accounting.ordinal_invariant: For every row, model operation_ordinal = resolver_ordinal + 1 exactly. resolver_ordinal is assignment/RNG zero-based; operation_ordinal is prompt/DSL one-based. No other offset or phase-global numbering is legal.
think_phase_resource_accounting.initialization_invariant: The first canonical call row of each Think phase has phase_tokens_remaining_before equal to its profile initial_phase_tokens, including a phase that will remain unopened or become NOT_TRIGGERED/NOT_INVOKED.
think_phase_resource_accounting.request_invariant: For an invoked recurrent Think row, requested max_new_tokens = min(512, phase_tokens_remaining_before). For structured one-shot Think it is min(15872, phase_tokens_remaining_before). A zero remainder forbids invocation.
think_phase_resource_accounting.debit_invariant: Charge raw_output_tokens before parsing for every invoked row, including malformed, illegal, timeout, or other response-bearing failure; require 0 <= raw_output_tokens <= requested max_new_tokens and phase_tokens_remaining_after = phase_tokens_remaining_before - raw_output_tokens. accepted_output_tokens, including JSON null on non-accepted output, never changes the debit.
think_phase_resource_accounting.continuity_invariant: Within a phase in ascending resolver_ordinal, each row's before value equals the preceding row's after value. A NOT_INVOKED/NOT_TRIGGERED/NOT_RUN row has raw_output_tokens=0 and after=before; every later retained row remains non-null and carries that unchanged remainder. No terminal or failure status erases the counter.
think_phase_resource_accounting.cumulative_invariant: For a phase, initial_phase_tokens - final phase_tokens_remaining_after equals the exact sum of raw_output_tokens across its scientific rows. Therefore recurrent D1 is at most 5120, recurrent D4 is at most 15872, and structured one-shot D4 is at most 15872. Replay tokens are charged only to process aggregates and never debit or rewrite the source scientific phase counter.

forecast_rule: Before the first model call, a hash-bound forecast must show every assigned call opportunity can fit all call, token, context, storage, device, and wall limits with the declared safety margin. If it cannot, the whole unopened scientific roster is NOT_RUN; no row is dropped, downsampled, truncated, moved to another runtime, or replaced.
aggregate_limit_invariant: The calculated roster maxima are exact assignment capacity, not soft estimates: 1709056 + 31744 = 1740800 output tokens and 56131584 + 1740800 = 57872384 combined tokens. The watchdog hard stops are independent containment ceilings: 1750000 - 1740800 = 9200 and 58000000 - 57872384 = 127616. These margins are unallocatable and cannot create a call, replay, longer output, retry, or cell. A preflight forecast must fit the calculated roster maximum strictly within each watchdog stop.
zero_science_preflight: After exact ratification, scoped implementation, creation and fresh independent acceptance of the newly rehashed executable snapshot, and explicit pre-GPU approval naming that snapshot—but before any scientific call—build/import the exact stack, resolve and verify the snapshot/tokenizer/chat template, tokenize every schema-generated maximum fixture, load the exact model once on one eligible device, and execute non-scientific load/context/allocation checks with zero generated model tokens. Failure is NOT_RUN; it cannot select alternate software, hardware below the minimum, TP, quantization, context, sampler, JCS, identifier, or accounting values.
mutation_rule: Changing any proposal-frozen algorithm/semantic or envelope member, any future executable-snapshot member or deterministically resolved source hash, an engine flag, sampler field, timeout, tokenizer/chat-template byte, seed/identifier mapping, resource invariant, or parser/JCS/Unicode identity invalidates the future executable snapshot. No between-stage repair is permitted, and this proposal itself is not that future snapshot.
